name: Local Cell Density
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: How crowded the tissue is around every cell.

params.name: k
params.label: Neighbours (k)
params.help: Sets how many nearest neighbours are used to estimate local density. Larger values measure density over a broader area and produce a smoother result.

params.name: scale
params.label: Scale
params.help: Sets whether density is shown directly or on a log10 scale.
